name: North Island, New Zealand
summary: Hobbiton and a week of geysers, with Auckland only at each end. The South Island fiords are a different trip.
why: This is the New Zealand trip for children who want the movie set and the mud pools. April is inside Hobbiton's busy season, and the town of Rotorua smells of sulphur. That smell is the place. Wellington and the alpine crossing are left out so the week stays in two bases.
distinctive: A working film set you can walk only with a guide, and a geothermal town a short drive south of it.
weather: April on the North Island is milder than the South Island and still brings rain. This is a seasonal pattern, not a forecast for April 2027.
crowds: Hobbiton says November to April is its busy season, and the standard tour can sell out weeks ahead. Rotorua is a holiday town, not a blossom-week city.
natureExperiences: Whakarewarewa or another geothermal field in Rotorua, chosen for the 6-year-old's walking limit
Lake Rotorua on a free day
A short look at the coast or a park in Auckland, not a city checklist
age6: Hobbit holes, mud and a boat if a lake trip is running. The standard Hobbiton walk is about two and a half hours on farm paths. Skip the evening banquet.
age12: The film set, the geysers, and time to wander Rotorua without a new town each day.
age14: The same days, plus the how-it-was-filmed talk. The Tongariro crossing is a separate, harder trip and is not in this plan.
adults: Two bases and a lot of free time. The film set is for the children. The geothermal field is the part that is still interesting if you have seen the films.
gettingAround: Two cars. Drive on the left. Auckland to the Hobbiton meeting point near Matamata is about two hours. Rotorua is under an hour further. Fly into Auckland and fly home from Auckland. Rotorua is not the international airport for this group.
meetingPoint: Auckland. Melbourne–Auckland is often nonstop, about 3 hours 40 minutes. Bengaluru–Auckland has no nonstop. Book one stop in Singapore or Kuala Lumpur. Do not book the Sydney connection. Ordinary Indian passports are not on Australia's transit-without-visa list. Confirm April 2027 times.
visaAu: Australian citizens travelling on an Australian passport do not need a visa or an NZeTA. Immigration New Zealand says an Australian Resident Visa is normally granted on arrival if character requirements are met.
visaIn: Indian passports are not visa-waiver passports. They need a visitor visa before travel, not an NZeTA. The visa is for New Zealand, not for one island. Tourism New Zealand's India page says the passport should be valid for at least 3 months after the planned departure from New Zealand. Early 2026 processing for Indian visitor visas averaged about 7 working days, with an 84% approval rate from January to April 2026. That is a recent statistic, not a promise for 2027.
disadvantages: You do not see Milford Sound, Tekapo or Wānaka.
Hobbiton is a guided visit on private land. You cannot drive up to the set.
A typical Auckland airfare from Bengaluru or Melbourne was not published in this pass, so the trip band excludes the international tickets.
Wētā Workshop is in Wellington. Reaching it means dropping Rotorua nights and taking another flight.
uncertainties: April 2027 Hobbiton availability for seven people.
Which geothermal walk is suitable that week. Read the operator's note for young children before you book.

lines.text: There is no nonstop from Bengaluru to Auckland. One-stop routes are published through Singapore, Kuala Lumpur and Sydney. A typical return fare was not published in this pass, so there is no group total. Do not use the Sydney stop. Ordinary Indian passports are not on Australia's transit-without-visa list.
Melbourne to Auckland is often nonstop, about 3 hours 40 minutes. A typical return fare was not published in this pass, so there is no group total.

Australian citizens pay no visa fee. For Indian passports, the May 2026 fees guide charges one visitor-visa fee of NZD 341 when a partner and dependent children are included, plus an NZD 100 levy for every person. Four people on one application would be NZD 741, about ₹40,000. Two separate family applications would be NZD 1,082, about ₹58,000. Four separate applications would be NZD 1,764, about ₹95,000. Which row applies depends on who can share an application.

cost.leftOut: International flights were not priced. Hobbiton tickets, geothermal entries, cars and the domestic hop are outside the flight lines.

trip.band: about ₹5–14 lakh before the international flights
trip.note: The visa fee is inside this. Fares from Bengaluru and Melbourne to Auckland were not published, so they are not.
trip.text: A band for seven people and about 13 nights, rounded to the nearest lakh. Not a quote, and not used to order the list. Three rooms, meals for seven, local transport and tickets. Six nights use Auckland's budget and mid-range columns and seven nights use Rotorua's, from Budget Your Trip. The Hobbiton ticket is the sort of entry this band is meant to cover, not a checked 2027 price. Insurance, bags and the international flights are outside it.

stretch16: Add two free days in Rotorua. Do not add Wellington unless you are willing to fly there and stay.
